KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

2. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.

3. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

4. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

6. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.

7. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

9. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
